description:
Stop the issue show and rollup tests in `crates/jit/tests/cli_issue` reading ids or values from human-readable output.

## Background

Shared test support provides one CLI process fixture, which reads the ids of issues it creates from `--json` output. These files still parse human-readable output with `split_whitespace`, mostly to scrape created ids. This entry covers `issue_show_projection_test.rs`, `issue_show_shape_test.rs`, `issue_show_summary_test.rs`, `issue_status_projection_tests.rs`, `container_rollup_tests.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No test in these files reads an id or other value from human-readable output; ids and values come from `--json` output.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each edited test asserts the property it asserted before and passes alone, in any order and in parallel.
title: issue show and rollup tests read created ids from JSON output
